title: 初一两对话：公交车与科学社
audio_introduction: Listen and choose the best answer.
instruction: 听两段完整对话，第一段2题，第二段3题，各从A/B/C选最佳答案。每材料听两遍。源未印精确读答停顿；本机每题前后各5秒，只作审阅编排，可重播。
source_notice: 初一公开月考说明中的完整题面、参考键和印出脚本已核，说明首行标合肥三十中/七上十月月考；原校施测及原版页面身份未独立认证。原音轨未取得，标题含音频不等于已取得。两遍有明文，精确读答时间未印；原参考键不是gold，原创录音不补成原源音频或学生标定。
timing_notice: 源未印精确读答停顿；本机每题前后各5秒，只作审阅编排，可重播。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Which bus goes to the swimming pool, Miss? Number Six?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Number Six goes to the park. You need Number Nine.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Thank you. Should I wait outside the bank?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No. The stop is outside the post office.

questions.stem: Which bus should the boy take?
questions.rationale: A：六路去公园；B：未提三路；C：九路去泳池
A：被明确否定；B：女士明确邮局外；C：公园是六路目的地

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Mina, does the science club meet on Tuesday?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: We usually meet then, but this week it is on Thursday.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Are we using the science room?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: No. We will meet in the library. We are going to make small paper bridges.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Do I need to buy any paper?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The club has enough paper. Just bring some glue.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: All right. I will put it in my bag now.

questions.stem: When is the meeting this week?
questions.rationale: A：平时周二，本周改了；B：明确this week Thursday；C：未说周五
A：明确small paper bridges；B：无小汽车；C：无纸船
A：社团纸足够；B：未要求剪刀；C：明确just bring glue
